001: Ivan, hi! Were you at the history lecture today?
Hi, Anna! Yes, I came, but I was ten minutes late.
Oh, what happened? You usually arrive on time.
The bus got stuck in traffic, there was nothing I could do.
I see. The professor probably noticed that you were late, right?
He noticed, but he didn't say anything. He just nodded at me.
002: Dmitry, are you going to the economics seminar?
Yes, I'm planning to. Aren't you going?
I am, but I need to stop by the library first to get the textbook.
Okay, I'll wait for you at the entrance to the classroom.
Great, I'll be quick. I'll just grab the book and come right away.
Deal, no need to rush, we still have time.
003: Sergey, how was yesterday's philosophy class?
Honestly, it was a bit boring. We spent the whole hour reading a text.
Yeah, I noticed you were looking out the window the whole time.
You're right, I got distracted. But afterwards I did write down the main points.
Good for you! And I think I missed something important at the beginning.
Don't worry, I can give you my notes.
004: Maria, do you know if there's a chemistry lab class tomorrow?
Yes, there is. I saw the schedule on the bulletin board.
Great, and what do we need to bring?
Probably a lab coat and a notebook for reports.
Thanks! And what time does the class start?
At ten in the morning, but it's better to come about five minutes early.
005: Alexey, hi! I didn't see you at the English class.
Hi, Olga! I was at the doctor's, I had an appointment.
Oh, I see. Did you find out what we covered?
Yes, I asked the teacher by email.
And what did he say? A lot of new material?
He said we went over new grammar. I'll copy all your notes.
006: Elena, have you signed up for the programming course yet?
Not yet, have you already signed up?
Yes, I signed up yesterday. There are only a few spots left.
Really? Then I need to hurry up and register.
Exactly, don't put it off. The group is small, only twelve people.
Thanks for the heads up! I'll sign up tonight.
007: Ivan, do you know which room the psychology lecture is in?
I think it's in room three hundred five, on the third floor.
Thanks! It's my first time going to this class.
No problem. Do you want to walk together? I'm going there too.
Sure, let's go. It's more fun together.
Then let's go, it's almost time to start.
008: Dmitry, did you do the math homework?
Yes, but two problems didn't match the answer key for me.
Same for me! I struggled with them all evening.
Maybe we can ask the teacher before class starts?
Good idea. He usually comes five minutes before the bell.
Perfect, we'll have time to ask him our questions.
009: Anna, do you go to all the literature lectures?
I try not to miss any, why?
It's just that I missed the last one, and now I don't understand the new topic.
No big deal. I can briefly tell you what we talked about.
That would be great! Maybe we can meet after classes?
Sure. Let's go to a cafe and talk it all over.
010: Sergey, have you seen the exam schedule? They say it's been posted.
Yes, I saw it, it's on the university website.
Great, and when is our first exam?
In two weeks, on Monday, in Russian language.
I see. So we need to start preparing right now.
Agreed. Maybe we can study together? It's more effective that way.
